title: Hal Puthoff ordered copies of UFOs and Nukes to give out in Washington

tellings.quote: when the first edition of UFOs and nukes came out he suddenly wrote to me and said I need four copies of the book shipped overnight
The person who ended up working with me was Dr. Harold “Hal” Puthoff.

The first edition of UFOs and Nukes was published in July 2008. At that time, it was only available at my website. In December of that year, Puthoff unexpectedly emailed me and asked that I overnight-ship four copies to him. When I checked into the delivery charge involved, it turned out to be more than a hundred dollars. I quickly wrote back to Puthoff, suggesting that I simply ship the books via US Postal Media Mail, which would take five days, but would be a much cheaper solution. Upon receiving my response, Puthoff immediately called me and said that he had an upcoming meeting with some “movers and shakers in Washington” two days hence, and he wanted to distribute copies of the book to them. At that, I rush-shipped the order.

plain: Hal Puthoff, a scientist who worked with the journalist Robert Hastings, is said to have rushed to get copies of Hastings's book UFOs and Nukes, first published in July 2008, so he could hand them to powerful people in Washington. Hastings tells this himself, on the show and in a 2024 article: in December 2008 Puthoff emailed asking for four copies shipped overnight, and when Hastings suggested cheaper slow mail, Puthoff called to say he had a meeting with "movers and shakers in Washington" two days later and wanted to give them the book. Hastings ties it to the secret Pentagon UFO program that The New York Times revealed on 16 December 2017, and if true it would mean his reporting reached the people who started that program.
